question: Which physicist is well known for his work on the elementary charge of electricity and the photoelectric effect?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Robert Millikan.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points:__**

__
 
• American experimental physicist **Robert Andrews Millikan** won the **Nobel Prize **in Physics in **1923** for his work on the **photoelectric effect **and measuring the** fundamental electric charge.**
 
• After graduating from **Oberlin College **in **1891**, Millikan went on to **Columbia University **where he earned his **PhD **in **1895**.
 
• He started off as an **assistant **at the **University **of **Chicago **in **1896, **and in **1910 **he was promoted to **full professor**.
 
• In order to ascertain the electric charge that a single electron carries, Millikan started a **series **of **experiments **in **1909**.
 
• He started by charting the motion of electrically charged **water droplets **in an **electric field.**
 
• The experiment was not precise enough to be conclusive, but the data revealed that the charge on the droplets is a multiple of the **elementary **electric **charge**.
 
• With his famous **oil-drop experiment,** in which he used oil instead of water (which had a tendency to evaporate too quickly), he was able to get more accurate results in **1910.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information:__**

 
• **Michael Faraday:** 

 
 
• An English scientist named Michael Faraday made contributions to the fields of **electrochemistry **and **electromagnetism**.
 
• His major discoveries include the fundamentals of **electrolysis, diamagnetism, **and **electromagnetic induction.**
 
 
 
• **JJ Thomson:**
 
 
• ​The **electron **was the first **subatomic particle **to be found, and Sir Joseph John Thomson, a British scientist and recipient of the Physics Nobel Prize, is credited with its discovery.
 
 
 
• **Christiaan Huygens:**
 
 
• ​As one of history's greatest scientists and a key player in the Scientific Revolution, Christiaan Huygens was a Dutch **mathematician, physicist, engineer, astronomer, **and **inventor.**
